title: Accounting and Tax Services for Chemical Manufacturers

rows.before: We claim capital cost allowance on Schedule 8, placing reactors, mixing vessels and filling lines bought before 2026 in Class 53 at 50% and later purchases in Class 43 at 30%; reclassifying one $600,000 reactor and filling line accelerated $150,000 of first-year CCA.
rows.after: We claim capital cost allowance on Schedule 8, placing reactors, mixing vessels and filling lines bought before 2026 in Class 53 at 50% and later purchases in Class 43 at 30%; reclassifying one $600,000 reactor and filling line accelerated $150,000 of first-year CCA.
rows.note: $600,000 here is an illustrative dollar amount (not the small business limit); leave as is.

rows.before: Accelerated roughly $150,000 of first-year Class 53 CCA on the $600,000 line
rows.after: Accelerated roughly $150,000 of first-year Class 53 CCA on the $600,000 line
rows.note: $600,000 here is an illustrative dollar amount (not the small business limit); leave as is.

rows.before: We incorporated the business and moved the mixers, tanks, inventory and formulations across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, set up raw-chemical, reactor-WIP and finished-goods inventory under section 10, and wrote the expired stock down to net realizable value.
rows.after: We incorporated the business and moved the mixers, tanks, inventory and formulations across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), set up raw-chemical, reactor-WIP and finished-goods inventory under section 10, and wrote the expired stock down to net realizable value.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 12.2% rate
rows.after: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 11.2% rate
